name: Are there different types of foggy window repair?

mainEntity.name: Are there different types of foggy window repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are generally two main approaches to addressing foggy windows. The most common and often recommended method is to replace the insulated glass unit (IGU) itself. This involves removing the old, compromised glass unit from the existing window frame and installing a brand new, factory-sealed IGU. The other method, sometimes called 'defogging' or 'de-misting,' involves attempting to remove moisture from the existing IGU and reseal it. While defogging can be a less expensive initial option, its long-term effectiveness can vary, and it may not fully restore the window's original thermal performance or clarity compared to IGU replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, common foggy window repair types include replacing the entire insulated glass unit (IGU) or, less frequently, attempting to 'defog' or 'de-mist' the existing unit.
